text:
Alex Chen: CI linkcheck failing on Docusaurus build, lots of anchor 404s on pages with brackets in headings.
Priya Patel: ugh saw that, example: "## Shipping [beta]" generates slug "shipping-beta" but links from sidebar use "shipping-beta"? ...actually the linkcheck shows both variants.
Samir Rao: sample error:
```
Link check failed: /docs/en/features#shipping-[beta] -> 404
```
Samir Rao: looks like the escaped brackets end up in the anchor on some pages and not others (i18n copy/translate step strips brackets)
Elena Gomez: Docusaurus slugify for MDX headings will drop certain punctuation, but if you include explicit `{#id}` it'll be stable across transforms.
Priya Patel: proposal: for headings that include bracketed flags, add explicit ids and update links to use the id. Less risky than mass renaming headings.
Alex Chen: I pushed a tiny PR that adds explicit ids for the problem headings in features + getting-started. https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4622
Maria Liu: nice. can we also add a short script to find headings with square/angle brackets and emit a recommended id? I can add to the PR.
Samir Rao: example snippet to auto-add ids (quick grep+sed):
```
# rough: convert "## Foo [beta]" -> "## Foo [beta] {#foo-beta}"
sed -E "s/^##\s+(.+)\[(.+)\]/## \\1[\\2] {#\L\1-\L\2}/" -i
```
Priya Patel: ^ that's rough but good as a start. we should normalize whitespace and strip punctuation for ids.
Alex Chen: CI: rerunning linkcheck after PR merge. docs-bot: triggered build 3487654330 by @alex
docs-bot: Linkcheck run queued, will post results.
docs-bot: Linkcheck finished: 14 files failed -> re-run requested
Elena Gomez: For i18n: translators should not copy bracketed flags into headings; we can add a lint rule to flag bracket tokens in translated headings.
Maria Liu: I'll add a tiny check in docs-lint: reject headings that contain "[" or "]"; suggest adding explicit id instead.
Samir Rao: once PR merged we should monitor the next run; if still fails, we may need to update the linkchecker config to follow fragment redirects.
Priya Patel: reviewers please: @Elena @Maria @Samir
Elena Gomez: reviewing now :eyes:
Alex Chen: thanks all, will merge after approvals. :thumbsup:
Priya Patel: ship it once green :shipit:
docs-bot: PR merged by Alex Chen (4622) at 3487654360
Alex Chen: confirming final linkcheck green in CI at 3487654370, closing thread.
